title: SecretShapedError

rule.description: What a refused text held: a shape rule's id, or registered-value for a value the environment holds as a secret.

field.description: The field of the refused write that held it: title or body for an issue or a pull request.

description: A text the harness would send out held a registered value or a shape rule's hit: data names the rule and the field, never the value, and nothing was sent.
